name: Oven Tandoori Chicken with Basmati Rice and Mint Yogurt

components.name: Tandoori Chicken
steps: Blend yogurt with oil, lemon, ginger, garlic, tandoori spices and salt. Coat raw drumsticks and marinate refrigerated 12-24 hours.
Heat oven to 180 C. Position chicken on a rack over a lined sheet pan, leaving a gap between pieces.
Roast roughly 20 minutes, brush with reserved marinade that has not been contaminated by cooked food, then roast another 15-20 minutes. Discard remaining raw-chicken marinade.
Increase heat to 220 C for the last 8-12 minutes to char the edges, ensuring chicken reaches 74 C internally.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Meanwhile, cook 300 g dry basmati with 520 ml water, covered, then rest for 10 minutes.

components.name: Mint Yogurt
steps: Mix mint yogurt from yogurt, chopped mint, lemon and salt. Pack separately cold. Portion rice and chicken across five meals, counting only edible chicken meat in served yields.
